GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Fast deterministic checks: unit tests with Mockk fakes + TraceRecorder for trajectory checks. Must run in < 10s per module for worker loops.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Checks only merged surfaces touched in the wave — integration tests against FakeYiApi + FakeCameraStreamServer.
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Full regression suite plus instrumented Compose UI tests on emulator; trace-coverage and redaction-scan must pass.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Every shared module needs: (a) fast module-local command, (b) both success and failure scenarios, (c) required markers that make divergence observable via TraceRecorder, (d) wave/phase follow-up, (e) stop-conditions for risky surfaces. Missing any item blocks autonomous execution.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never log tokens, auth headers, passwords, raw stream bytes, AES keys, device serial numbers, or user PII (email/phone) in plaintext. Verified by RedactionScanner on every captured trace.
GlobalPolicy.redaction-scan-rule: RedactionScanner asserts no forbidden-substring match in any captured TraceRecorder output. A single match fails the module gate.
GlobalPolicy.trace-coverage-rule: Every required-log-marker listed in a V-M-* entry must appear at least once in the module's passing test trace. Missing marker = verification defect.
GlobalPolicy.evidence-precedence: deterministic > trace > integration > semantic. Never replace a working exact assertion with a fuzzy semantic check.

EvidenceTypes.type-deterministic: Exact assertion on return value, state transition, error code, or invariant. First choice wherever equality is stable.
EvidenceTypes.type-trace: Assertion on ordered BLOCK markers, branch decisions, retry counts, or forbidden-marker absence via TraceRecorder. Used when trajectory matters.
EvidenceTypes.type-integration: End-to-end check across merged surfaces using FakeYiApi / FakeCameraStreamServer / in-memory Room. Used at wave and phase level.
EvidenceTypes.type-semantic: Bounded LLM evaluation with explicit rubric + contract + observed trace. Used ONLY when domain correctness cannot be expressed with stable asserts (e.g. thumbnail visual quality). Never as a substitute for a working exact check.

harness-1.name: TraceRecorder
harness-1.purpose: Captures Timber output into an ordered list of [Module][fn][BLOCK] markers + structured fields. Provides assertMarkerAppeared, assertMarkerAbsent, assertSequence, assertMaxRetries, assertRedactionClean.

harness-2.name: RedactionScanner
harness-2.purpose: Scans a captured TraceRecorder buffer for forbidden substrings (token patterns, 'password', AES key bytes, email/phone regex, Authorization header). One match fails the gate.

harness-3.name: FakeYiApi
harness-3.purpose: In-memory Yi Cloud API mock with scripted responses per endpoint (/v1/account/login, /v1/user/camera/list, /v1/camera/event/list, /v1/camera/control, /v1/camera/live/key). Supports delay, 401, 5xx, and network-failure injection.

harness-4.name: FakeCameraStreamServer
harness-4.purpose: Local socket server emitting a scripted AES-128-encrypted test H.264 stream with known key/iv. Enables deterministic M-STREAM-DECODE verification without a real camera.

harness-5.name: FakeAuthStore
harness-5.purpose: In-memory EncryptedSharedPreferences fake backed by a map; lets tests assert token storage without Android Keystore roundtrip.

harness-6.name: InMemoryRoom
harness-6.purpose: Room database built with in-memory SupportSQLiteDatabase for M-LOCAL-DB and cache tests.

harness-7.name: StreamHandleFake
harness-7.purpose: Fake StreamHandle that emits scripted StreamState transitions + fps/latency values for M-STREAM-LIVE UI tests.

AutonomyReadiness.global-gate: Autonomous multi-agent execution is allowed once: (1) TestInfrastructure harnesses exist and compile, (2) all "ready" modules pass module-local checks, (3) every "conditional" module has its stop-conditions implemented and a captured sample on disk referenced in docs. Until then, run $grace-execute (sequential) only.

StopConditions.global-stop-1: Any reverse-engineered Yi Cloud endpoint shape changes or returns unexpected fields -> halt the affected module and replan against a fresh capture.
StopConditions.global-stop-2: A RedactionScanner failure (secret in logs) -> halt immediately; redaction is a hard gate, not a warning.
StopConditions.global-stop-3: A required-log-marker does not appear in a passing test trace -> treat as verification defect; add the marker or fix the test before proceeding.
StopConditions.global-stop-4: Native/build failure persists after 2 attempts -> halt and escalate; do not loop on build environment issues.
